checkpoint: step2116 EMA, same archived Belay model as prior sweep
fp4_scope: E2M1 with FP8 block scales (16 values) and FP32 per-row scale, emulated quantize/dequantize at routed-expert input. Forward still uses BF16 communication and matrix arithmetic. Packed communication is a separate microbenchmark; no native NVFP4 throughput claim.
activation_scope: Isolated copy of pinned model; unsquared ReLU for routed, shared or both expert groups. Unchanged-copy control must match native reference exactly.
normalization_scope: Replace block input RMS normalization with learned gain only; replace learned gated normalization with constant 1/2 or identity. Attention Q/K and latent norms remain unless FP4 wrapper explicitly quantizes the latent-normalized input.
sparsity_scope: One routed expert; omit shared experts; fixed token-ID hash selects distinct random experts as an approximation baseline. No retraining or adaptation.
